seoTitle: iOS Crash Report Viewer for .crash and .ips Files
metaDescription: Format Apple crash reports: device, OS, exception, termination reason and the crashed thread backtrace. Free, does not upload.
intro: Reads .ips JSON and older text crash reports and shows the key facts first.
why:
Crash reports are long. The things you need first are the exception type, the termination reason and the backtrace of the crashed thread.

This tool formats them, but it does not symbolicate. Frames marked not symbolicated need your dSYM files, which Xcode or atos use.
howTo: Open the .ips or .crash file or paste its contents.
Tick the option to list other threads.

faq.a: The JSON crash report format used by recent iOS and macOS versions.
The report holds addresses and image offsets. Symbols need the dSYM matching the build.
